studyMetadata.title: Data Literacy Study
studyMetadata.description: Participants rate their interest in five topics, then critique a treemap and a line chart drawn from their most and least interesting topics.

uiConfig.studyEndMsg: Thank you for completing the study.

response.prompt: Do you consent to the study and wish to continue?

topicInterest.description: Participant's interest in five broad topic categories.

critiqueTreemapHigh.description: Critique of a 3D treemap about the participant's most interesting topic from topicInterest.
critiqueTreemapHigh.instruction: First, please speak out loud to describe what you are thinking as you look at the chart and make sense of it. While doing so, please apply your own knowledge and experiences to the chart in order to better understand it. Next, Please critique the following visualization. Please discuss any aspects of the visualization you like or dislike, and describe your reasoning. Finally, provide and any suggestions you have for improvement.

response.prompt: Have you finished critiquing the visualization?
